name: CGPE Claim OCR (Gemini)
description: WhatsApp insurance claim OCR: webhook receives a base64 PDF, Gemini extracts + analyzes it, customer gets a receipt, 3 admins get red-flags with APPROVE/REJECT, claim stored in MongoDB.

parameters.jsCode:
const b = $input.first().json;
return (b.admins || []).map(function(to){ return { json: { waUrl: b.waUrl, waToken: b.waToken, to: to, adminText: b.adminText, buttons: b.adminButtons } }; });

parameters.content:
## CGPE Claim OCR (Gemini)
POST a claim PDF (base64) to /cgpe-claim-webhook. Gemini reads and analyzes it, the customer gets a receipt, the 3 admins get red-flags with APPROVE/REJECT, and the claim is stored in claim_analyses.

## Setup
1. Fill the Gemini API Key credential (Header Auth): header name x-goog-api-key, value = your Gemini key.
2. Meta WA Token and MongoDB creds are reused from the main bot.
3. wa_bot_config must have phoneNumberId and graphVersion.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ mediaId: $('Prep Input').item.json.mediaId, token: $('Prep Input').item.json.token, graphVersion: $('Prep Input').item.json.graphVersion, mimeType: $('Prep Input').item.json.mimeType, claimNumber: $('Prep Input').item.json.claimNumber }) }}
